title: A planted check for a latency goal times each input shape that takes a slower code path, not only plain text
goal: the sprint skill's plan step 6 tells the planner that a check proving a latency or time figure times each input shape that takes a slower code path (a redaction trigger such as an IPv4 or a home path, a first call that loads data), not only a plain input

run:
import re,sys
t=open('skills/sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
s=t.split('## plan',1)[1].split('\n## ',1)[0]
step=[p for p in re.split(r'\n(?=\d+\. )',s) if p.startswith('6. ')]
sys.exit(0 if step and re.search('slower code path',step[0],re.I) else 1)
